description: Query Monitor Logs telemetry data from OneUptime. IMPORTANT: telemetry tables are large — always filter by a time range and keep limits small (e.g. 10-50). Each field accepts a direct value (exact match) or an operator object {"_type": "<Operator>", "value": ...}. Operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween (numbers/dates), Search (partial text), Includes (array of values). Example — items from the last 24 hours: {"createdAt": {"_type": "GreaterThan", "value": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}}.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default: 10, Maximum: 100. Keep small for telemetry queries.

query.description: Filter criteria for Monitor Logs. Always include a time-range filter. Each field accepts a direct value (exact match) or an operator object {"_type": "<Operator>", "value": ...}. Operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween (numbers/dates), Search (partial text), Includes (array of values). Example — items from the last 24 hours: {"createdAt": {"_type": "GreaterThan", "value": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}}.

select.description: Fields to return, as an object of field names to true (e.g. {"time": true, "body": true}). Select only the fields you need — telemetry rows can be large.

createdAt.description: Select createdAt field in the response

logBody.description: Select logBody field in the response

monitorId.description: Select monitorId field in the response

projectId.description: Select projectId field in the response

retentionDate.description: Select retentionDate field in the response

time.description: Select time field in the response

skip.description: Number of records to skip. Default: 0.

sort.description: Sort order. Use "ASC" or "DESC". Example: {"time": "DESC"} for most recent first.

name: list_monitor_logs
